title: Stance & Focus Adverbs
goal: Qualify assertions and express stance using sentence-level adverbs like 'francamente', 'en rigor', and 'rotundamente'.

items: Use stance adverbs such as 'francamente' and 'lamentablemente' to show my attitude to a whole sentence.
Tell a stance adverb, set off by commas, from an adverb that describes the action.
Place a stance adverb at the start, in the middle or at the end with the right commas.
Be exact with 'en rigor', 'en realidad' and 'propiamente dicho'.
